hints.content: To find the image of $\triangle ABC$ under the dilation, we can dilate all of $\triangle ABC$'s vertices and connect them.

For example, point $\blueD C$ is $4$ units to the right of $P$ and $4$ units down, so its image is $\goldD{\dfrac12}\cdot4=2$ units to the right and $\goldD{\dfrac12}\cdot 4=2$ units down from $P$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: Triangle A B C. Point B is two units to the left of point P and two units up, Point C is four units right from point P and four units down, and Point A is eight units right of point P and four units up. There is a dashed line to highlight horizontally four units right point P and vertically four units down. Another dashed line highlights horizontally two units right and two units down. There is another plotted point that is two units right from point P and two units down.

hints.content:
Let's do the same thing with the remaining vertices.

Since our scale factor is $\goldD{\dfrac12}$, every side length in $\triangle A'B'C'$ will be $\dfrac{1}{2}$ the length of the corresponding side in $\triangle ABC$.

Another way to think about it is that since our scale factor is $\goldD{\dfrac12}$, every point in the image will be exactly in the middle between its corresponding point in the pre-image and our center $P$.

Connecting the vertices of the image, we get the following mapping:



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: Triangle A B C. Point B is two units to the left of point P and two units up, Point C is four units right from point P and four units down, and Point A is eight units right of point P and four units up. There is another triangle graphed that is triangle A B C with a scale factor of one half from point P. The new triangle the Point B prime is one unit to the left of point P and one unit up, Point C prime is two units right from point P and two units down, and Point A prime is four units right of point P and two units up. The distance between C prime and B prime is approximately four point two units. The distance between C prime and A prime is approximately four point five units. The distance between A prime and B prime is approximately five point one units.

question.content:
**Draw the image of $\triangle ABC$ under a dilation whose center is $P$ and scale factor is $\dfrac{1}{2}$.**
